Name: Lanternwood Grove
Author: pluviophist
Description:
[center][size=5][font=Courier New][color=#e69138]Welcome to Lanternwood Grove![/color][/font][/size][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=3]This map originally began as a reimagination of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29615]Four Acres[/url][/size][/font][size=3][font=Times New Roman] map, but overtime, became a unique creation of its own. I'm aiming for a sort of Italian countryside look with this one, featuring rolling hills, large natural crop fields, small streams, and green forested thickets.. 
A special thanks to Delloti﻿, whose [url=https://blog.naver.com/delloti/223845564429]Greenbell Fields[/url] farm was the main inspiration.
This map also has quite a few quirks and non-typical functions, so please be sure to read the entire description before downloading![/font][/size][/center]
[center].[/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][b]There are two download options: Four Corners replacement, or a new farm type. [u]Only download one[/u].[/b] [/font][/center]

[/center]

[left][font=Times New Roman][size=4][color=#cc4125]✿[/color][b] [color=#e69138]Config Options[/color][color=#f4f4f4]:[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]TWO map sizes to pick from: Standard size and smaller size. [b]Both options are available in the config settings.[/b][b] [/b][/color][/font]
[spoiler][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4][img]https://i.imgur.com/dzKb1VI.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/color][/font][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]TWO versions of each size: Standard decor, and no decor [[i]removes animal pens, lampposts, etc.[/i]] [b]Both options are available in the config settings[/b]. [/color][/font]
[spoiler][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4][img]https://i.imgur.com/EBTLsBg.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/color][/font][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]
[size=4][color=#6fa8dc]✿[/color] [b][color=#93c47d]Map Features[/color][color=#f4f4f4]:[/color][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Large crop fields with markings for sprinklers and scarecrows[/color][/font]
[spoiler][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4][img]https://i.imgur.com/SmIf123.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/color][/font][/spoiler]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Animal pens with invisible barriers [[i]no gates necessary[/i]!][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Various lampposts, lanterns, fireflies, and other map lighting [/color][/font]
[spoiler][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4][img]https://i.imgur.com/PA6a7Mv.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿[/color][/font][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Renewable hardwood stumps [/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]A quarry that generates stone & ore daily[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Various minecarts [[i]you must complete the minecart bundle![/i]], warps, and shortcuts to provide fast travel around the farm[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]4 different hot spring entrances for health and stamina regeneration[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Beach cove area, where you can forage items and find washed up boxes [[i]similar to the beach farm map[/i]][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]The player plaza acts as a communal area. Share furnaces, chests, or just decorate it if you're playing solo![/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]4 vast spaces/sections, making this a great option for 4+ multiplayer[/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#cc4125]NOTE[/color]: The thickets of trees found around the map are actual trees that can be tapped, cut, and replanted. To keep the spreading of trees under control, the tiles surrounding and within the thickets will NOT spawn trees, and no more can be planted [[i]other than in place of an existing tree[/i]]. This does not include fruit trees, which can be planted in the thickets, so long as the surrounding tiles are clear. Trees will grow and spread in the open meadows like normal. [/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Times New Roman][size=5][size=4][color=#a64d79]✿[/color][b] [color=#ea9999]Installation[/color]:[/b][/size][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config[/url]﻿ [Optional, but makes configuration easier][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilsheets[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]Crystalinerose's Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Download this mod[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]Run the game using SMAPI[/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]To uninstall, delete this mod from Mods folder[/color][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][color=#f4f4f4]
[size=4]✿ [/size][b]Enjoy the map, and please let me know if you come across any issues[/b].[size=4] ฅ(^•ﻌ•^ฅ) ♡[/size][/color][/font]
